notes.title: The (almost) Fully Voice Acted Update
notes.content:
It has been an amazing 2 weeks since launch, with tons of great reviews and kind words. This community is truly special and we appreciate each and every person who has taken the time to play the game and give feedback!

A huge mega ultra thank you to Jerma for playing the game on stream! It was so much fun seeing him and chat react to all the jokes and references. Even better, he inadvertently voice acted like 75% of the games dialogue!

You can watch a recap of the stream where he [strike]talks about smushing his balls[/strike] plays this game, as well as Jerma's Big Adventure, another amazing fan game by the wonderful worblir. Check it out if you somehow haven't already.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V5gwS6qssIM

Ever since the stream I've been hard at work adding his voice lines to the game, and it's finally ready! It's not complete, so there will be some random dialogue without voiceover, but it's very cool nonetheless.

So without further ado:

[h2]v1.2.0[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 180 recorded voice lines.
[*] Added a speech volume slider to the settings.
[*] Added a fullscreen toggle to the settings for that one guy.
[*] Added a honk SFX when you interact with the clowns.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.2 Minor Fixes - October 10th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The Loogame achievement is achievable now, and includes 1 additional Jerma, bringing the total to 8. 
[*] Fixed a bug in the maze that would teleport the player out of bounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could break the Blackjack minigame by pressing Enter.
[*] Fixed a bug in Bottle Busters that would let you shoot bottles while the game is paused, also lowered the difficulty of the game slightly.
[*] Minor fixes to dialogue and continuity details.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has left a review and who has been keeping track of bugs in the discussion section. There's been plenty of discussion over the blackjack and bottle minigames, and whether they should be necessary to continue the game. I'm currently working on some ideas for the bottle minigame which should be ready for the next update.

Thanks again Jermamites! ː8bitheartː
